#Goal
In '/DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_technology/Explore_existing_data/CM20250902_collect_hopping_data.Rmd' I started collecting all the mapped hopping data we have.
This file turned into a messy mix of collecting files and some preliminary analysis. In /DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_technology/Explore_existing_data/CM20251128_collect_mapped_ints_clean.Rmd I collected them cleanly again.
Here I will add the last new data (mapped in E2916).

Steps:
collect all ints
combine tables and save
filter for local and save 


##Notes
1. I want  all data to be processed with Koen's version of the tagmap pipeline (which we currently also use), so for E1682 I re-ran the pipeline.
This collection does not include the hopping data from the Omar clones, because they have a very different set-up (is analysed separately).

2. Lise LP Nanog (now called N1) 
Lise has annotated it in her scripts as: 122650131
But if I map the sequence from my snapgene file to the genome the positions of the two junctions are 122653214 and 122653232.
The mapping pipeline of Koen gives 122653234, 122653235 which matches the snapgene file (+2bp) so I will take those locations. 

# Setup
##Libraries
Load the libraries and set the parameters.
```{r load_libraries}

# Load dependencies
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(gtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)

split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}
```

# Sox2 locus
## Published
First just load the published data. Only load the control pools
```{r}
#file paths
path_tib_23_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/still_to_upload/mapped_integrations_-116kb_Sox2P_pools.txt"
path_tib_C9_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/mapped_integrations_-161kb_Sox2P_pools.txt"
path_tib_C10_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/still_to_upload/mapped_integrations_+715kb_Sox2P_pools.txt"
path_tib_C9_41_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/mapped_integrations_-161kb_Sox2P_CDS_pools.txt"
path_tib_C9_mChneg_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/still_to_upload/mapped_integrations_-161kb_Sox2mCherrydel_Sox2P_pools.txt"
path_CRE6_ints = "/DATA/projects/Sox2/GEO_collection/Tagmentation/mapped_integrations_short_neutral_insert.txt"


#landing pads
landingPad_23 <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr3", 
                    ranges = IRanges(start = 34643961,
                                     end = 34643962),
                    strand = "+")

landingPad_C9 <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr3", 
                    ranges = IRanges(start = 34598479,
                                     end = 34598480),
                    strand = "+")
landingPad_C10 <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr3", 
                    ranges = IRanges(start = 35478413,
                                     end = 35478414      ),
                    strand = "+")

LP_tib = tibble(landing_pad = c("23", "C9", "C10"), 
                start = c( start(landingPad_23),start(landingPad_C9), start(landingPad_C10)))


#load the -116kb data (LP23)
tib_23_all_data = read_tsv(path_tib_23_ints) %>%
  filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X")))) 

#the control pool in E2285 (rep3) was sequenced as 10 separate libraries, combine them into one sample
tib_23_E2285_ctrls = tib_23_all_data %>%
  filter(replicate == "rep3" & insert == "Sox2P" & sample_type == "control pool") %>%
  mutate(sample_name = "Sox2P-reporter -116 kb, unsorted control pool rep3")%>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2), .groups = "keep") 

tib_23 = tib_23_all_data %>%
  #select the rest of the data
  filter(!(replicate == "rep3" & insert == "Sox2P" & sample_type == "control pool")) %>%
  select(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name,
         read_count, read_count_1, read_count_2)%>%
  #add merged controls back in
  bind_rows(tib_23_E2285_ctrls) %>%
  #mark hopped integrations
  mutate(hopped = start != 34643961)


#load the -161kb data (LP C9)
tib_C9 = read_tsv(path_tib_C9_ints) %>%
  filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X")))) %>%
  #combine the 2 libraries of "Sox2P-reporter -161 kb, population P1 pool1 rep2"
  mutate(to_merge = case_when(replicate == "rep2" & insert == "Sox2P" & sorted_gate == "P1" ~ "merge",
                              .default = sample_name)) %>%
  mutate(sample_name = case_when(to_merge == "merge" ~ "Sox2P-reporter -161 kb, population P1 pool1 rep2",
                             .default = sample_name)) %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2), .groups = "keep") %>%
  #mark hopped integrations
  mutate(hopped = start != 34598479)
  
#load the +715kb data (LP C10)
tib_C10 = read_tsv(path_tib_C10_ints) %>%
  filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X")))) %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2), .groups = "keep") %>%
  #mark hopped integrations
  mutate(hopped = start != 35478413)


#load the -161kb mCh- data (LP C9)
tib_C9_mChneg = read_tsv(path_tib_C9_mChneg_ints) %>%
  filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X")))) %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2), .groups = "keep") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #mark hopped integrations
  mutate(hopped = start != 34598479) 

#load the -161kb mCh+ Sox2P_CDS data (C9_mCh_41)
tib_C9_41 = read_tsv(path_tib_C9_41_ints) %>%
  filter(chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X")))) %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, replicate, experiment, launch_pad_location, insert, genotype, sample_type, sorted_gate, pool_nr, sample_name) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2), .groups = "keep") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #mark hopped integrations
  mutate(hopped = start != 34598479)

#load the minimal insert (CRE6) data
tib_E2226 <- read_tsv(path_CRE6_ints) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = "23_CRE6",
         population = "ctrl") %>%
  mutate(experiment = "E2226") #typo in the experiment number!
                  
  
#E2226 had 10 control reactions sequenced with separate indices, here we combine them to get comparable data to the other experiments (with 1 index pair for the control pool)
tib_E2226_comb = tib_E2226 %>%
  group_by(cell_line, population, chr, start, end, seq, strand, experiment) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2)) %>%
  mutate(hopped = start != 34643961)  %>%
  mutate(launch_pad_location = "-116 kb",
         insert_name = "CRE6",
         insert = "minimal insert",
         sample_type = "control pool",
         genotype = "WT",
        sample_name = 'CRE6 -116 kb, unsorted control pool rep1')

#filter the integrations
tib_Sox2_ctrls  <- bind_rows(tib_23, tib_C9, tib_C10, tib_C9_41, tib_C9_mChneg, tib_E2226_comb)  %>%
  filter(sample_type == "control pool") %>%
  #add variables used in the plotting (old names of cell lines etc) 
  mutate(cell_line = case_when(launch_pad_location == "-116 kb" & insert == "Sox2P" ~ "23_34A",
                               launch_pad_location == "-161 kb" & insert == "Sox2P" & genotype == "WT" ~ "C9_mCh_34",
                               launch_pad_location == "-161 kb" & insert == "Sox2P" & genotype == "Sox2::mCherry deleted" ~ "C9_mCh-_34",
                               launch_pad_location == "-161 kb" & insert == "Sox2P_CDS" & genotype == "WT" ~ "C9_mCh_41",
                               launch_pad_location == "+715 kb" & insert == "Sox2P" ~ "C10_34",
                               .default = cell_line),
         landing_pad = case_when(launch_pad_location == "-116 kb" ~ "23",
                                 launch_pad_location == "-161 kb" ~ "C9",
                                 launch_pad_location == "+715 kb" ~ "C10")) %>%
  #filter the data
  filter(!(start >= 34721183 & start <= 34721192)) %>% #remove contamination from LP8
  filter(! start %in% c(25018987, 35232946) ) %>% #remove contamination clone C1
  filter(landing_pad  == "C9" | start != 34598479) %>% #remove contamination from LP C9
  filter(landing_pad  == "23" | start != 34643961) %>% #remove contamination from LP 23
  filter(landing_pad  == "C10" | start != 35478413) %>% #remove contamination from LP C10
  filter(strand %in% c("+", "-")) %>%
  mutate(LP_chr = "chr3",
         LP_coordinate = case_when(launch_pad_location == "-116 kb" ~ 34643961,
                                 launch_pad_location == "-161 kb" ~34598479,
                                 launch_pad_location == "+715 kb" ~ 35478413))

```


## Unpublished

E2555, Sox2_mChdel_CDS
```{r}
#get file locations
E2555_rep1_ints = '/DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_Sox2_mTurq/E2555_mapping_integrations/pipeline_results_rep1/mm10/home/insertions'
E2555_rep2_ints = '/DATA/usr/m.eder/projects/Tn5_tagmentation/E2555/pipeline_results/mm10/home/insertions' 

metadata_E2555_41_mChdel = tibble(file = dir(c(E2555_rep1_ints, E2555_rep2_ints) ,
                   recursive = T, full.names = T)) %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), "\\..*")) %>%
  filter(grepl("41_mCh-", sample) & grepl("_ctrl", sample))


# Load all files
ints_E2555_41_mChdel <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(metadata_E2555_41_mChdel),
                        function(i) {
                          tmp <- read_tsv(metadata_E2555_41_mChdel$file[i],
                                          col_types = cols(
                                            .default = col_character(),
                                            start = col_double(),
                                            end = col_double(),
                                            read_count = col_double(),
                                            mapq = col_double(),
                                            read_count_1 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_1 = col_character(),
                                            read_count_2 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_2 = col_character(),

                            mutate(sample = metadata_E2555_41_mChdel$sample[i])
                        })) %>% 
  select(-c(region_start, region_end)) %>%

         replicate = str_extract(sample, "^rep[0-9]"))
```

```{r}

metadata_CTCF_delDE = bind_rows(metadata_E2282, metadata_E2347, metadata_E1665, metadata_E2226)

                        function(i) {

                                          col_types = cols(
```

Combine all, and annotate + filter
```{r}
tib_ints_unpub = bind_rows(ints_E2555_41_mChdel, ints_E2285_E2292_E2401_comb, ints_E2138_A1, ints_CTCF_delDE_comb) %>%
  mutate(landing_pad = case_when(sample == "A1_ctrl" ~ "A1",
                                 experiment == "E2292" ~ "8",
                                 experiment == "E2555" ~ "C9",
                                 .default = "23"),
         genotype = case_when(grepl("D2", sample) ~ "delD2",
                              grepl("E12", sample) ~ "delE12",
                              grepl("mCh-", sample) ~ "Sox2::mCherry deleted",
                              .default = "WT"),
         insert_name = case_when(grepl("41", sample) ~ "41",
                                 grepl("MK01", sample) ~ "MK01",
                                 grepl("MK02", sample) ~ "MK02",
                                 grepl("MK03", sample) ~ "MK03",
                                 grepl("MK2", sample) ~ "MK02",
                                 grepl("MK3", sample) ~ "MK03",
                                 grepl("34", sample) ~ "34",
                                 sample == "A1_ctrl" ~ "34",
                                 genotype %in% c("delD2", "delE12") ~ "34",
                                 experiment == "E1665" ~ "CBS16",
                                 grepl("CRE", sample) ~ "CRE6",
                                 grepl("16A", sample) ~ "16A",
                                 grepl("3xCTCF", sample) ~ "3xCTCF",
                                 grepl("CBS16", sample) ~ "CBS16",
                                 sample == "CTCF_ctrl_20" ~ "3xCTCF",
                                 .default = "unknown"
                                 ),
         insert = case_when(insert_name == "34" ~ "Sox2P",
                            insert_name == "41" ~ "Sox2P_CDS",
                            insert_name %in% c("16A", "CBS16") ~ "1xCTCF_rv", #check with Mathias, I'm 90% sure they are both in rv orientation
                            insert_name == "3xCTCF" ~ "3xCTCF_fw",
                            insert_name == "CRE6" ~ "minimal insert", 
                            insert_name == "MK01" ~ "3xCTCF_fw_Sox2P",
                            insert_name == "MK02" ~ "3xCTCF_rv_Sox2P",
                            insert_name == "MK03" ~ "1xCTCF_fw_Sox2P"
                            )) %>%
  filter(landing_pad  == "8" |!(start >= 34721183 & start <= 34721192)) %>% #remove contamination from LP8
  filter(! start %in% c(25018987, 35232946) ) %>% #remove contamination clone C1
  filter(landing_pad  == "C9" | start != 34598479) %>% #remove contamination from LP C9
  filter(landing_pad  == "23" | start != 34643961) %>% #remove contamination from LP 23
  filter(landing_pad  == "C10" | start != 35478413) %>% #remove contamination from LP C10
  filter(strand %in% c("+", "-")) %>%
  mutate(LP_chr = "chr3",
         LP_coordinate = case_when(landing_pad == "23" ~ 34643961,
                                 landing_pad == "C9" ~34598479,
                                 landing_pad == "A1" ~ 34754848,
```

Martijn's E2703, this is a relatively less complex pool (it is sorted for being hopped, we can estimate the maximum complexity from labguru). Consider if we should filter these for at least 2 reads per int. 
Estimated complexity (see E2694):
Transfected ~3M cells with SB transposases
At sorting GFP+ signal, 0.036% of cells were GFP+
0.00036*3M = 1080 cell complexity of hopped sorted cells (of which we estimate ~half have a reinsertion)

This experiment cannot be used for hopping efficiency estimation because it is sorted for hopping out (but sorting was not pure). However, it is not sorted for a biological phenotype so it can still tell us about the hopping distribution.

### clones
The first round of clones (E2288) is useless because there were so few hopped clones.
However, in the second round (E2409) Martijn had 331 clones of which ~half had integrations. I load those here as well

```{r}
MappingDataDir_E2409 = '/DATA/usr/m.verkuilen/Projects/project96_enhancer_hopping/E2409_CM2253_tagmap/pipeline_output/mm10/hopping/insertions_ref'

# List all files
metadata_E2409 <- tibble(file = dir(MappingDataDir_E2409, 
                   recursive = T, full.names = T)) %>%
  # filter(grepl("insertions_ref", file)) %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(file), "\\..*")) 

#split pools and clones
metadata_E2409_clones = metadata_E2409 %>%
  filter(grepl("cl", sample)) %>%
  filter(sample != "cl223") #empty file, gives issues in the parsing below

metadata_E2409_pools = metadata_E2409 %>%
  filter(grepl("plP", sample))
#there is also a non-template control, I don't need that sample

#clones are mapped only from one side
ints_E2409_clones <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(metadata_E2409_clones),
                        function(i) {
                          tmp <- read_tsv(metadata_E2409_clones$file[i],
                                          col_types = cols(
                                            .default = col_character(),
                                            start = col_double(),
                                            end = col_double(),
                                            # gap_concordance = col_double(),
                                            read_count = col_double(),
                                            mapq = col_double(),
                                            # read_count_1 = col_double(),
                                            # mapq_1 = col_character(),
                                            # read_count_2 = col_double(),
                                            # mapq_2 = col_character(),
                                            # sump = col_double(),
                                            # p_adj = col_double()
                                          )) %>%
                            mutate(sample = metadata_E2409_clones$sample[i])
                        })) %>%
  mutate(type = "clone")

#pools are mapped only from both sides
ints_E2409_pools <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(metadata_E2409_pools),
                        function(i) {
                          tmp <- read_tsv(metadata_E2409_pools$file[i],
                                          col_types = cols(
                                            .default = col_character(),
                                            start = col_double(),
                                            end = col_double(),
                                            read_count = col_double(),
                                            mapq = col_double(),
                                            read_count_1 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_1 = col_character(),
                                            read_count_2 = col_double(),
                                            mapq_2 = col_character(),
                                          )) %>%
                            mutate(sample = metadata_E2409_pools$sample[i])
                        })) %>%
  mutate(type = "pool")

#all pool samples come from the same 520 cell pool (sorted for GFP+), so combine all indices here
ints_E2409_pools_grouped = ints_E2409_pools %>%
  filter(!sample %in% c("plP5-2", "plP6-2")) %>% #these appear to be separate PCRs on the same enrichment, so not more information just PCR duplicates
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, type) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count),
            read_count_1 = sum(read_count_1),
            read_count_2 = sum(read_count_2)) %>%
  mutate(sample = "unsorted_pool")


ints_E2409 = bind_rows(ints_E2409_clones, ints_E2409_pools_grouped) %>%
  select(-c(region_start, region_end)) %>%
  mutate(experiment = "E2409",
         insert = "pMV001",
         LP = "N2") %>%
  mutate(LP_chr = "chr6",
         LP_coordinate = 122702875) #Based on home read mapping, check this!

ints_E2409_filtered = ints_E2409 %>%
  filter((type == "pool" & read_count >= 2) | #~500 cell pool is exhaustively sequenced, so filter for at least 2 reads
           (type == "clone" & read_count >= 10)) #more strict than Lise's data, because sequenced deeper

#we expect there to be overlap between pools and clones, since they come from the same hopped pool
# we really only want to see each unique integration once
ints_E2409_filtered %>%
  group_by(chr, start, strand) %>%
  summarize(N_samples_found = n()) %>%
  mutate(genotype = "WT")

ints_E2409_unique = ints_E2409_filtered %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, seq, strand, experiment, insert, LP, LP_chr, LP_coordinate) %>%
  summarize(read_count = sum(read_count))

#E2409 is a bit different from the other experiments (pools and clones from the same hopping, lot's of redundancy), so I'd rather keep it separate to keep my combined tibble easier to interpret
# write_tsv(ints_E2409_filtered, "/DATA/usr/c.moene/projects/Hopping_technology/Explore_existing_data/rds/CM20250916_E2409_filtered_ints.tsv")
```

## landing pads lise
These launch pads are based on either Lise's snapgene file of the launch pad (align the overhangs there to the genome in IGV and take the end coordinates), or on the mapping data from the clones (based on my running of Koens pipeline).
Often this does not exactly match Lise's annotation in her github, I am not sure why?
Also, for F108 and N37 the pipeline could not make a 'integrations' file, so I took the location from 'putative insertion' folder, I am not sure why the pipeline failed on those samples. 


```{r}

LP_coordinates_Lise_vc = c(
  #coordinates based in Lise's snapgene files of the launch pads
  Fzd5 = 'chr1:64993495-64993508:+', 
  Tdgf1 = 'chr9:110927616-110927619:-', 
  N1 = 'chr6:122653234-122653235:+', #originally called 'Nanog'
  #coordinates found in mapping from E1682 (either the real output or putative insertions)
  #F = Fzd5, N = Nanog
  T3 = 'chr9:109077493-109077494:-', #new pipeline does not give location for T3, but 'putative insertion' shows 109077493, 109077494
  T201 = 'chr9:112440263-112440264:+', #T201 has 2 real integrations, don't use it for analysis
  T48 = 'chr9:109626921-109626922:-',
  F108 = 'chr1:79293542-79293543:-', #old pipeline, does not give 1bp insertion locations, gives: 79293302-79293543 #new pipeline does not give location for F108, but 'putative insertion' shows 79293542, 79293543
  N31 = 'chr6:143694589-143694590:+',
  N37 = 'chr6:109001000-109001001:-', #old pipeline, does not give 1bp insertion locations, gives: 109000598-109001146 #new pipeline does not give location for N37, but 'putative insertion' shows 109001000, 109001001
  T137 = 'chr9:110925103-110925104:+'
)

LP_coordinates_Lise_tib = tibble(LP = names(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc),
                                 chr = str_extract(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc, "chr."),
                                 start = str_remove_all(str_extract(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc, ":[0-9]*-"), ":|-"),
                                 end = str_remove_all(str_extract(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc, "-.*"), "-|:|\\+"),
                                 strand = substr(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc, str_length(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc),str_length(LP_coordinates_Lise_vc)))
LP_coordinates_Lise_gr = GRanges(LP_coordinates_Lise_tib) 

LP_coordinates_Lise_tib_2 = LP_coordinates_Lise_gr %>%
  resize(width = 1, fix = 'center') %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(-end, -strand) %>%
  dplyr::rename(LP_chr = seqnames,
                LP_coordinate = start) 
```



## filtered data Lise
```{r}

chromosomes <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X"))


tib_ints_Lise = bind_rows(tib_E1792_E1828, ints_E1682) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = chromosomes)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(chr) %>%
# Add factor 'LP' describing source of hopping
  dplyr::mutate(
    LP = case_when(
      #the original LPs created by Lise via knockin
      grepl("Fzd5_", sample) ~ "Fzd5",
      grepl("Tdgf1_", sample) ~ "Tdgf1",
      grepl("Nanog_", sample) ~ "N1", #originally called 'Nanog'
      #the clones that Lise re-hopped
      grepl("N37_", sample) ~ "N37", 
      grepl("N31_", sample) ~ "N31", 
      grepl("F108_", sample) ~ "F108",
      grepl("T201_", sample) ~ "T201",
      grepl("T137_", sample) ~ "T137", #
      grepl("T48_", sample) ~ "T48",
      grepl("T3_", sample) ~ "T3",
      .default="unknown"),
    type = case_when(grepl("_D", sample)  ~ "pool", #D = days after transfection
                     grepl("_FACS", sample)  ~ "pool",  #pool samples, I expect taken on day of FACS sorting clones, not sure
                     grepl("_cl", sample)  ~ "clone",
                     .default = "unknown"
                     )
    ) %>%
  left_join(LP_coordinates_Lise_tib_2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LP_chr = factor(LP_chr, levels = chromosomes))

#filter at least 5 reads for clones
tib_ints_Lise_filt = tib_ints_Lise %>%
  filter(read_count >= 5 | type == "pool")
```

# Combine all

```{r}
all_ints_comb = tib_ints_Lise_filt %>%
  mutate(insert_name = "LoxP", 
         insert = "minimal insert") %>%
  bind_rows(all_ints_Sox2) %>%
  bind_rows(ints_E1962) %>%
  bind_rows(ints_E2048) %>%
  bind_rows(ints_E2913)%>%
  bind_rows(ints_E2409_filtered)%>%
  bind_rows(ints_E2288_grouped) %>%
  bind_rows(ints_E2703_filtered) %>%
  mutate(insert = case_when(insert == "CRE6" ~ "minimal insert",
                            .default = insert),
         genotype = case_when(is.na(genotype) ~ "WT",
                              .default = genotype))
```
